question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given Idiom.**

Close to one’s heart
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Dear and important to oneself.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of the given idiom:-
 
• **Close to one’s heart** - personally important to, or loved by, someone. (किसी के लिए व्यक्तिगत रूप से महत्वपूर्ण, या उसके लिए प्रिय)
 
 
• For Example - That old dog is very **close to my heart**.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4**.
